searchText: Hey Chris, i am interested in creating a specification if anyone hasn't jumped in and done it yet. I work closely with <@504202741933932544> and we had few discussions about it. I suppose I can post a PR to the mev-boost docs ( https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost ) and then have further discussion on the PR itself. Wdyt? Sounds great. The builder-specs repository would also be a good fit, both work from my perspective. Great, i will work on a markdown document and think where to raise the PR afterwards The first mev-boost security audit has completed, with a few minor findings on mev-boost, and one medium issue that should be clarified in the relay documentation: https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/issues/161#issuecomment-1184476809 <@388610194608750595> just received a 204 on kiln ```text time="2022-07-14T17:43:00Z" level=info msg="no bids received from relay" method=getHeader module=service parentHash=0x0ad2af45a403f00efb2e12481855ef29d20ec257799a6ca71830cdb1906244af pubkey=0xaabfab9b8d7a487bf7912ba89377e950993b92aa82598043af6d82e105670ac6e2582e8e0dc964b979b74a1a5ecf4402 slot=901090 time="2022-07-14T17:43:00Z" level=info msg="http: GET /eth/v1/builder/header/901090/0x0ad2af45a403f00efb2e12481855ef29d20ec257799a6ca71830cdb1906244af/0xaabfab9b8d7a487bf7912ba89377e950993b92aa82598043af6d82e105670ac6e2582e8e0dc964b979b74a1a5ecf4402 204" duration=0.06918571 method=GET module=service path=/eth/v1/builder/header/901090/0x0ad2af45a403f00efb2e12481855ef29d20ec257799a6ca71830cdb1906244af/0xaabfab9b8d7a487bf7912ba89377e950993b92aa82598043af6d82e105670ac6e2582e8e0dc964b979b74a1a5ecf4402 status=204**** ``` we intercepted it correctly (like it was pre finalization) but i'm wandering if everything is ok on your side Yes that's not unexpected! Not every slot has a block from our builder. the logic I've been using is, if 200, continue, else bail, and maybe report/log error -- is that correct?
